takes.situation: She takes the Fixer for the Bureau, dodges, then says yes before hearing what she's agreed to.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who saw you? Is it my Bureau card? It's two stamps behind.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not the Bureau, Inez. Softly. We know you're seeing Okafor.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: The Office guard? I've six tables waiting. Can it be after?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: The Office could learn of you both. I won't dress it up.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: All right. Yes. Whatever it is, yes. Just not the Office.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Hear it first. I telephone, you call Okafor off the Office door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: He'd come, that's the pity. I'd say it can't go by telephone.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Say that. Okafor stands with you a few minutes, then walks back.

learned: She hates it, knows Fixer's face.

takes.situation: The talk is already under way; she guards Okafor with questions and asks what the empty door is for.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: I could have gone to the Office first. I came to you.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who can hear you? Gone with what? The shift's about to change.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Quietly. You and Okafor. One note down the tube, the Office knows.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: What's Okafor done? Does he know you've been watching us?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: He knows nothing. When I telephone, you call Okafor off the door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: What happens at the Office door while he's with me?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: That's ours to carry. A few minutes, then Okafor walks back.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I'll say there's something I can't tell on the line. Now go.

learned: Threatened, she agreed; knows Fixer's face.

takes.situation: She turns the Fixer's manners back on them, then has to invent the reason that brings Okafor over.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: The clockwork's been for the Bureau already. 'At your convenience.' You too?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: We're not the Bureau. The Office could learn about you and Okafor.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Has anyone seen you here? Don't tell the Office. Just say what.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: I don't enjoy this. When I telephone, call Okafor off the door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: You're as polite as the clockwork. Okafor won't leave for nothing.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Softly, then. Give Okafor a reason. You'd know better than we would.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I'd say I've something to tell, and not on the line.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Keep Okafor at your side a few minutes. Never say anyone knows.

learned: Inez gave in, knows Fixer's face.
